title: Regulatory Effectiveness and Validity Period
summary: The regulatory provisions evolved from simple effective dates to incorporating specific expiration dates, reflecting a shift toward time-bound policy enforcement. This transition marks a move from indefinite validity to defined sunset clauses for customs notifications.

evolution.validity_structure: Transitioned from indefinite validity to time-bound expiration periods.

timeline.change: Establishment of standard effective date clause.
Introduction of a sunset clause (validity until 2026-06-30) alongside the effective date.
